items.position: Technical Advisor & Content Creator  (FL & de bono)

items.position: Programme Manager and Technical Coaching (de bono)
items.description:
After meeting the CEO in Zurich, I helped grow his virtual OMDENA organization from zero to 2000+ AI engineers doing de bono coaching of new AI talents and assigning them to international NGO projects such as
* AI-Powered Crop Yield Prediction from Satellite Imagery for Food Security (various Africa)
* AI-Powered Rooftop Solar Assessment eliminates 30-40% of pre-sales survey costs (India).
* Detecting Wildfires Using CNN Model with 95% Accuracy (Americas)
Here I have grown with the advent of tangible AI when AI was still laughed at. With Omdena, we have always been at the forefront of what was coming next with AI. And this is the main reason I am still working de bono with these wonderful AI enthusiasts around the globe! OMDENA is my real passion & heart program that allows me to draw from a portfolio of proven, implemented, real-life, hands-on AI projects and wonderful, top-notch field experts around the globe.

Advising the Spinlaunch space company on choosing and setup of collaboration tools for the orchestration of their global network of international experts. Reimplemented the proven Omenda / Swiss Hyperloop approach, but had to switch to NASA in-house tools. Contract terminated prematurely because Spinlaunch has decided to employ US citizens only.

Evaluation, setup, operation and presentation of a celebrated, AI driven, hybrid shared service center prototype for Swiss eGov administrations. Close partnership with Senseforth.ai to bring state of the art, AI driven service-center technologies to Switzerland. Demo -> https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AEPP2rW4aQ0 (C#, .NET, MS Copilot, SQL, REST, Mulesoft, git, ClickUp a.o.).

Having now 2 kids and my wife back into the corporate world with a 100% job, I have decided to leave the corporate world and work as an independent freelance ad interim IT project leader, program office manager & consultant, open-source contributor, and workshop facilitator for many international organizations mentioned above, drawing from my experiences.

From there I have finally combined the two separate paths into consulting and troubleshooting for leading conversational AI providers such as Senseforth.ai (India), Cognigy.ai (DE), and IBM Switzerland with a focus on ready-made conversational components (ChatBots) and AI integration.
